title: SourceTagAttachment
description: Represents a source-synced tag attachment on an asset. When tags from external systems (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, BigQuery) are synced to Atlan, they appear in the classification's attributes as SourceTagAttachment objects. This structure contains details about the source tag including its name, qualified name, connector, and any tag values.

properties.name: sourceTagName
properties.description: Name of the tag in the source system (e.g., 'CONFIDENTIAL').

properties.name: sourceTagQualifiedName
properties.description: Fully qualified name of the source tag (e.g., 'default/snowflake/1726834662/ANALYTICS/WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS/CONFIDENTIAL').

properties.name: sourceTagGuid
properties.description: GUID of the source tag asset in Atlan.

properties.name: sourceTagConnectorName
properties.description: Connector type for the source system (e.g., 'snowflake', 'databricks', 'dbt', 'bigquery').

properties.name: isSourceTagSynced
properties.description: Whether the source tag is currently synced with the external system.

properties.name: sourceTagSyncTimestamp
properties.description: Epoch timestamp (milliseconds) of the last sync with the source system.

properties.name: sourceTagValue
properties.description: Array of tag values attached to this source tag. Each value contains a tagAttachmentValue string.
